feeds.headline: Flash Update: Dialysis transport at risk if CORR-01/CORR-02 close
feeds.summary: OCHA recommends coordinated holds between Nassau Metro NEMT and Princess Margaret / Doctor's Hospital transport desks. P1 dialysis patients flagged across both hospital partners.
